description: Base config without automerge: config:best-practices (pinned GitHub Actions and Docker digests, weekly lock file maintenance, pinned npm devDependencies, abandonment detection, config migration PRs, 3-day release age for npm only), semantic commits and one grouped PR for patch and stable minor updates. No custom release age: other updates are proposed as soon as they are released.

packageRules.description: Do not update the composer php platform requirement: it is not a package, so Composer cannot update it in composer.lock (the lock update fails and the content-hash goes stale). The minimum PHP version is a project decision: change it by hand
One PR per repo for every patch update. Overrides the monorepo groups from config:recommended for patches
Add minor updates of stable (>= 1.0) dependencies to the same PR. 0.x minors keep their own PRs: a group is automerged only if every update in it is, and 0.x minors are never automerged

Trial set of PR table columns, for every update (Current value, New value and Package file already removed). Overrides the narrower set from config:recommended (mergeConfidence:age-confidence-badges). Delete the lines you do not need.
